sRGB2014.icc is the unmodified sRGB v2 profile from the International Color Consortium.
Source: https://registry.color.org/rgb-registry/profiles/sRGB2014.icc
Profile documentation: https://registry.color.org/rgb-registry/srgbprofiles
License source: https://registry.color.org/profile-library/

This profile is made available by the International Color Consortium, and may be copied,
distributed, embedded, made, used, and sold without restriction. Altered versions of this
profile shall have the original identification and copyright information removed and
shall not be misrepresented as the original profile.

The profile is included unchanged, with its original embedded copyright information.
